heater_off.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) disables the integrated heater on the sensor with the given ID. After turning off the heater, allow several minutes for the sensor to cool down before expecting accurate readings.

heater_on.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) enables the integrated heater on the sensor with the given ID. The heater can be used to remove condensation from the humidity sensor or to verify sensor functionality.

address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x44`. Supported addresses are `0x44` through `0x47`.

*See also: [HDC302x Temperature and Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hdc302x#configuration-variables)*

humidity.docs:
The information for the humidity sensor.

*See also: [HDC302x Temperature and Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hdc302x#configuration-variables)*

BALANCED.docs: Balance between accuracy and power usage.

LOW_POWER.docs: Lower power usage, faster, less accurate.

ULTRA_LOW_POWER.docs: Lowest power usage, fastest, least accurate.

power_mode.docs:
**enum**: The power mode used when triggering temperature and humidity measurements. This affects measurement accuracy and sensor power usage.

*See also: [HDC302x Temperature and Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hdc302x#configuration-variables)*

temperature.docs:
The information for the temperature sensor.

*See also: [HDC302x Temperature and Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hdc302x#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [HDC302x Temperature and Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hdc302x#configuration-variables)*
